Welcome to the Hotel Marlowe. This is a short recording about the hotel, in English. Your room is on the fifth floor. There are two elevators, and they are next to the front desk. Breakfast is on the first floor, from seven to ten in the morning, every day. There is coffee and there is tea all day in the lobby, and it is free. There is no restaurant here at night, but there are three good ones on the same street, two minutes from the entrance. If you need anything, there is a telephone in your room. Press zero for the front desk. Thank you, and have a very good stay.

Hey, it's me. I'm in the hotel now, and I want to tell you about the room, because you asked. It's small, but it's very good. There is a big bed, there is a desk near the window, and there is a safe in the closet for my things. There is no coffee machine, and that is the only problem. The bathroom is fine. There are two big towels and there is a lot of hot water, so I am happy. My room is on the fifth floor, and there are two elevators, so I never wait. Breakfast is from seven, and I am always the first one there. Okay, call me tonight. Bye.
